# Files this branch is allowed to touch, enforced by tools/git-hooks/pre-push.
# PROJECT.md, CHANGELOG.md and this file are always allowed.
#
# `*` matches within one path segment; `**` crosses slashes. A pattern must
# reach a file: tools/**, not tools.
#
# Note this does NOT say .github/pr-scope/** — that would grant this branch write
# access to every other branch's scope file, and a guardrail that can edit its
# siblings is a poor example for the branches that copy it.
tools/**
README.md
